Default when `d.closed` is absent/falsy: the Path stays open (Paper.js's own construction default for a freshly-`new Path({insert:true})`), never explicitly set to `false`.

Reads `d.segments` (the array of `{point,handleIn,handleOut}` triples — serP:715 `segments:p.segments.map(...)`) to rebuild each `Segment` via `new Point(...)` triples; no default when absent — `d.segments.length` is read unconditionally, so a dict with no `segments` field throws rather than falling back to an empty path. Restores `prev=project.activeLayer` before switching (837) so `prev.activate()` (896) can restore it afterward — `desP` is transparent to whichever layer was active before it ran, letting a caller invoke it repeatedly across different target layers (e.g. `loadFrame`'s per-layer loop) without manually re-activating anything between calls.
